scope: RELIANCE September 1-4 only; no later outcomes or reserved holdout
action: LONG if score > 0 and abs(score) >= threshold; SHORT if score < 0 and abs(score) >= threshold; otherwise abstain. Zero never trades, including threshold zero.
selection_predictions: Use the existing forward folds: fit Sep1 for Sep2 and fit Sep1-2 for Sep3. Never use all-four-day fitted predictions to select the threshold.
selection_objective: Maximize equal-day mean signed speed-discounted utility per decision, with abstention worth zero; not accuracy alone. Require at least 30 selected signals total and five on each selection day. If no eligible combination has positive utility, select no trading.
secondary_accuracy_diagnostic: After the primary sweep, report the highest-accuracy eligible combination selected ONLY on Sep2-3; ties prefer more signals then a lower threshold. This secondary comparison was added after seeing the tuning grid but before examining its Sep4 performance. It does not replace the primary selection objective or authorize promotion.
tie_break: Prefer fewer components, then stronger regularization, then the smaller threshold.
locked_model: Selected specification fitted only through Sep3, with the threshold chosen without Sep4 labels. Save these exact coefficients, not a post-test refit.
honesty: Sep4 and the formula families were examined in the preceding study. This is a chronological replay check, NOT a new untouched test. Four days cannot establish generalization. Threshold grid is fixed before this new sweep, but the score range was already known.
signal_metrics: Coverage, signal counts by side/day, correct first-target accuracy, opposite-first and neither counts, eventual target hits, 1/3/5/15/30-minute hit rates, fast recall, hit-time distribution, and speed-discounted utility. Adjacent signals overlap and are not independent trades.
trade_diagnostics: Separately replay the locked selected model/threshold with the existing deterministic sizing, exits, feasibility, and portfolio rules. Report costs, net and gross P&L, win rate, drawdown, duration and exits; use the previously stated 1s latency, 2bp half-spread, 1bp slippage scenario. Do not optimize thresholds on replay P&L.
unchanged: Target 0.2%, five-minute decay, feature families, exits, position sizing and all frozen parent artifacts remain fixed. No live orders. Results remain research-only.
